question: 图中性能比I7-13700K好的AMD CPU有几个？

steps.description: Locate the Intel I7-13700K CPU entry in the performance comparison chart
Understand that upward arrows indicate better performance in the chart
Find the AMD R9-7950X CPU entry in the AMD column of the chart
Find the AMD R9-7950X3D CPU entry in the AMD column of the chart
Find the AMD R9-7900X CPU entry in the AMD column of the chart
Count the number of AMD CPUs that have better performance than I7-13700K
